_comment: Workstation permission posture. Composed from controls/authorization/client-side/settings.json with operator-home paths instead of /etc/agents, since a laptop has no system-managed agent directory. defaultMode dontAsk auto-denies anything not explicitly allowed, asked, or approved by the PreToolUse hook. Valid modes are default (aka manual), acceptEdits, plan, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions. There is no deny mode; the deny LIST is what blocks specific tools.
_setup: Copy to ~/.claude/settings.json, then install the hooks: cp ../../controls/authorization/client-side/pre_tool_use.sh ~/.claude/hooks/ && chmod +x ~/.claude/hooks/pre_tool_use.sh

permissions._comment_deny: Destructive verbs, plus the workstation-specific Read denials below: credential and SSH material an agent on a laptop can otherwise read. That block is the difference from the cluster profile, where secrets are not in the agent's mount namespace to begin with.
